name: AppMD
description: App Metadata document: design-time, app-level domain metadata (enums, lookup tables, schema fragments, configuration JSON) that drives metadata-driven programming and is consumed by the app's functions and agents. Authored in Trillo AI and moved to the app's backend on deploy (like classes/functions/agents — not file/bucket storage; content lives inline in the DB, a few MB max). Organized as a tree via a materialized 'path' (folders are implicit in the path; there is no folder table). Uniqueness is (appId, path, name). Read-only via generic CRUD; authoring goes through the App Metadata endpoints.

attributes.name: appId
attributes.description: App this document belongs to. Stamped on deploy/create; immutable.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Document owner (author). Drives the row-level ownership filter.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Materialized folder path, '/'-separated (e.g. 'lookups/geo'). Defines the tree; folders are implicit. Empty = root; a single segment = one level. Listed by exact match (a folder) or prefix (a subtree).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document name, unique within its path. The full address is path/name (e.g. 'lookups/geo/countries').

attributes.name: contentType
attributes.description: MIME type of the content (application/json | text/csv | text/plain). Drives the editor mode and how the content is parsed at runtime.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional one-line description of the document.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The metadata body, stored inline in the DB (a few MB max). JSON/CSV/text per contentType.
